causebase_summary: Enfield Baptist Church Inc (displayed as Enfield Baptist Church) operates from 1 Francis Ave, Broadview, South Australia and offers weekly Sunday services at 10:00am that attendees can join in person or watch online. The organisation’s website hosts an archive of previous sermons and a calendar of upcoming events. The site names specific programs including “Lifewell Ministries” and an “Aged Care Volunteer Visitors Scheme”; the latter is presented as a volunteer program. The website provides contact and connection pages and invites people to “Get Connected” and “Join Us,” and it links to social media (Facebook, YouTube). The ACNC extract for 2022–23 reports revenue of $892,389 and total expenses of $821,437 for the 01/07/2022–30/06/2023 reporting period. The organisation’s website includes a statement that it “longs to see lives deeply transformed by Jesus,” presented here as the organisation’s stated purpose. No detailed descriptions of program eligibility, participant numbers, or the operational footprint beyond the Broadview location are provided in the available evidence.
